tasks.BusJourneyMN: Calculate the number of ways to travel from M to N using 3 buses.
tasks.BusJourneyNO: Calculate the number of ways to travel from N to O using 4 buses.
tasks.BusJourneyPQ: Calculate the number of ways to travel from P to Q using 3 buses.

answer: The total number of ways to travel from M to Q is the product of the number of ways for each segment: 3 * 4 * 3 = 36.
